extracted.name: Fig, burrata & prosciutto tartine
extracted.description: Use larger slices of sourdough in these tartines for an impressive-looking lunch or starter that's deceptively easy
ingredient_lines: 8 slices of prosciutto or parma ham
4-6 ripe figs roughly torn or halved
handful of thyme or oregano, leaves picked
instruction_lines: Heat a griddle pan over a high heat or heat the grill to high. Or if using an air fryer, heat to 200C. Drizzle each side of the bread with a little olive oil, then toast in the pan or under the grill for 2 mins, or in the air fryer basket for 4 mins on each side, until golden brown.

Spread the fig chutney over the toasted bread. Tear or chop the burrata into chunky pieces and arrange these on the toast, create little nests of prosciutto on top, then add the fig pieces. Sprinkle with the thyme, then drizzle with more olive oil and a little balsamic vinegar.
